title: Interest Rate Buydown Product Schedule: Rate Reductions, Points and Floors
content:
The Interest Rate Buydown is offered by Larkspur Home Lending in seven products. A **temporary** buydown is a payment subsidy for the first loan years; a **permanent** buydown is discount points paid to lower the note rate. The schedules below set, for every product, the size and length of the reduction, the points involved and the limits on the payment rate. Rates and reductions are in percentage points to 3 decimals; points are stated to 3 decimals.

## Schedule A: payment-rate reductions by loan year

A loan-year reduction is the amount by which the payment rate in that loan year sits below the note rate.

| Product | Buydown type | Loan year 1 reduction | Loan year 2 reduction | Loan year 3 reduction | Loan years with a temporary payment reduction | Largest yearly increase of the payment rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | temporary | 1.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 1 | 1.000 |
| Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown | temporary | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.000 | 2 | 1.000 |
| Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | temporary | 2.000 | 1.000 | 0.000 | 2 | 1.000 |
| Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown | temporary | 3.000 | 2.000 | 1.000 | 3 | 1.000 |
| Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | permanent | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0 | 0.000 |
| Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | permanent | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0 | 0.000 |
| Larkspur Three-Point Permanent Buydown | permanent | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0 | 0.000 |

## Schedule B: points, note-rate reduction and payment-rate limits

| Product | Note rate reduction bought by the points | Discount points paid | Most discount points accepted on a loan | Dollar basis of one point | Lowest payment rate any year may reach | Decimal places for each month's payment difference |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | the loan amount | 2.000% | 2 |
| Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | the loan amount | 2.000% | 2 |
| Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | the loan amount | 2.000% | 2 |
| Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.000 | the loan amount | 2.000% | 2 |
| Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | 0.250 | 1.000 | 1.000 | the loan amount | 2.000% | 2 |
| Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | 0.500 | 2.000 | 2.000 | the loan amount | 2.000% | 2 |
| Larkspur Three-Point Permanent Buydown | 0.750 | 3.000 | 3.000 | the loan amount | 2.000% | 2 |

## Reading the schedule

The figures in these readings are hypothetical note rates chosen for illustration; the reductions, points and floor are the schedule's own.

- **Payment rate year by year, temporary product.** On a hypothetical note rate of 6.875% under the Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown, the payment rate is 4.875% in loan year 1 (6.875 less 2.000), 5.875% in loan year 2 (6.875 less 1.000), and 6.875% from loan year 3, where the reduction is 0.000. Each yearly increase is 1.000 percentage point.
- **The floor.** On a hypothetical note rate of 4.500% under the Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown, the loan year 1 rate before the floor would be 1.500% (4.500 less 3.000). That is below the lowest payment rate any year may reach, 2.000%, so the loan year 1 payment rate is 2.000%.
- **Note rate, permanent product.** On a hypothetical note rate of 6.875% before points, the Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown pays 2.000 discount points and the note rate is lowered by 0.500, to 6.375%. A permanent product has no loan-year payment reductions and no yearly increase of the payment rate.

## Points of reference

- *Which products involve discount points?* Only the three permanent products: 1.000, 2.000 and 3.000 points respectively. Each temporary product shows 0.000 points paid and 0.000 points accepted.
- *On what dollar amount is one point priced?* On the loan amount, for every product.
- *How many loan years carry a temporary reduction?* One for the Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown, two for the Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown and the Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown, three for the Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown, none for a permanent product.
